Hi Lucy / Karthik / Priya,

Apologies for the slightly longer reply — here’s the package and quick answers to Procurement’s questions. Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025-2026.pdf; soc2-bridge-letter-2026.pdf; hosting-architecture-eu.pdf. Signed DPA is available via the Drive link below.

Summary answers (short):
- SOC 2 Type II report: attached. This report covers the audit period April 1, 2025 — March 31, 2026 and was issued by an independent CPA firm.
- Bridge letter: attached. Our bridge letter attests that controls in scope remain in place and operative through September 30, 2026, and is signed by our Head of Compliance (can provide exec signature on request).
- Data residency / hosting: for Redwood Hosted API (standard offering), production customer data (data plane) is stored in AWS eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) and not replicated outside the EU. Backups are retained in the same region.
- Control plane and telemetry: the control plane (management APIs and orchestration) and minimal routing metadata operate from EU-hosted services for EU customers. Aggregate telemetry used for product health is pseudonymized; raw customer request payloads are not exported to the US.
- Logs / support traces: logs that include customer identifiers are retained in the EU. We do not export identifiable customer data outside the EU except where a customer explicitly requests cross-border support and signs an exception; such exceptions are logged and require a documented legal basis and the customer’s approval.
- Transfer mechanism: we support the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) in our DPA and maintain a signed DPA record for customers. A link to the signed DPA: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Greenline_Security_Pkg (PDF copy in folder).

Scope note: SOC 2 scope covers the Redwood Hosted API and associated infrastructure and operations as described in the attached report. If Greenline is evaluating Dedicated or Private deployments, those have different boundaries; please flag if that’s the case.

Next steps we propose:
- Procurement reviews the attached SOC 2 and bridge letter.
- If the wording is acceptable, sign the DPA (link above) and we’ll countersign via DocuSign (link below).
- If you need an executive-signed bridge letter (CEO/CISO), we can provide that within 48 hours after DocuSign initiation.

DocuSign link (for bridge letter / DPA countersign): https://docusign.com/link/ABC123-greenline

If you have specific audit checklist items (SIG/CAIQ questions) we can map evidence to the controls — share the checklist and I’ll have our control owners produce artifacts.

Attachments referenced (stubs):

- hosting-architecture-eu.pdf (PDF, 450KB)
